newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi king returns to Jeddah from holy sites.
newsitem.headline: Saudi king returns to Jeddah from holy sites.

text.p: Saudi Arabia's King Fahd arrived in Jeddah on Saturday after spending the last days of the Moslem fasting month of Ramadan in the holy city of Mecca, state-run Saudi television reported.
The Saudi monarch traditionally spends the last 10 days of Ramadan in holy sites in western Saudi Arabia.
Earlier in the day, King Fahd and Crown Prince Abdullah marked the Islamic Eid al-Fitr feast by expressing their concern over bloodshed in Moslem countries.
The Eid holiday marking the end of Ramadan lasts five days in Saudi Arabia and three days in other Moslem countries.
